<style>/* SC Soluções Automotivas — production styles */
:root{--red:#df272f;--red-dark:#c71e27;--ink:#14171b;--muted:#6a737e;--paper:#f5f6f8;--white:#fff;--line:#e7e9ec;--soft:#f0f2f4;--dark:#0e1013;--radius:28px;--page-width:1250px}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:102px}body{margin:0;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);font-family:Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}body.no-scroll{overflow:hidden}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}button{font:inherit}img,svg{display:block;max-width:100%}button,a{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f07075;outline-offset:4px}::selection{background:#ff858a55}.container{width:min(calc(100% - 88px),var(--page-width));margin-inline:auto}.skip-link{position:fixed;top:-100px;left:16px;padding:12px 20px;background:#fff;color:#12151a;z-index:300;border-radius:12px}.skip-link:focus{top:16px}.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;font-size:11px;font-weight:780;letter-spacing:.175em;color:#7b838b}.eyebrow-dash{width:21px;height:2px;background:var(--red);display:block;flex-shrink:0}.eyebrow-light{color:#d5dbe3}.button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;border-radius:999px;padding:17px 25px;border:1px solid transparent;font-size:14px;font-weight:740;white-space:nowrap;min-height:52px;transition:transform .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease,background .22s ease}.button:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}.button-red{background:var(--red);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 16px 35px #d622302d}.button-red:hover{background:var(--red-dark);box-shadow:0 20px 45px #d6223040}.button-outline-light{color:#fff;background:#ffffff19;border-color:#ffffff69;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}.button-outline-light:hover{background:#ffffff30}.button-light{color:#252a30;background:#fff;border-color:#e6e8ea}.section{padding:122px 0}.section-heading{margin-bottom:47px}.heading-line{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:70px}.heading-line h2{font-size:clamp(38px,5.2vw,72px);letter-spacing:-.075em;line-height:1.01;margin:20px 0 0;font-weight:770;max-width:810px}.heading-line h2 span{color:var(--red)}.heading-line>p{max-width:360px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.78;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 4px}.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,24px,0);transition:opacity .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),transform .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}.reveal.is-visible{opacity:1;transform:none}
/* Floating navigation */
.nav-island{position:fixed;top:18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:110;width:min(calc(100% - 40px),1180px);height:75px;border-radius:23px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);box-shadow:0 12px 45px rgba(12,19,28,.12),0 1px 2px #00000009;backdrop-filter:blur(25px) saturate(1.5);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(25px) img{width:57px;height:auto}.brand-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;line-height:1}.brand-copy strong{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:-.05em}.brand-copy a{font-size:13px;color:#626b76;font-weight:660;transition:color .2s}.desktop-nav a:hover{color:var(--red)}.nav-buttons{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.nav-buttons>a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:11px;min-height:44px;padding:0 /* Hero */
.hero{position:relative;height:min(930px,100svh);min-height:740px;border-radius:0 0 32px 32px;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;background:#13171c}.hero-image,.hero-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0}.hero-image{background:url('../img/hero.webp') 50% 52%/cover no-repeat;transform:scale(1.045);animation:heroIn 13s ease-out both}.hero-overlay{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(3,6,9,.92) 0%,rgba(4,7,9,.82) 29%,rgba(4,7,9,.48) 56%,rgba(4,7,9,.15) 100%),linear-gradient(0deg,#080b0f96 0%,transparent 36%)}.hero-layout{height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;z-index:2;padding-top:35px;padding-bottom:96px}.hero-copy{max-width:870px}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(72px,8.2vw,124px);font-weight:760;line-height:.935;letter-spacing:-.091em;margin:31px 0 22px}.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:#ff434c}.hero-copy>p{max-width:550px;margin:0;font-size:clamp(16px,1.6vw,19px);line-height:1.72;color:#e4e8ee}.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:30px}.hero-side-note{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;position:absolute;right:-5px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(90deg);transform-origin:50% 50%;font-size:10px;font-weight:720;letter-spacing:.26em;color:#dbe0e6;white-space:nowrap}.note-line{width:52px;height:1px;background:var(--red)}.hero-float{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:30px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:4;width:min(calc(100% - /* Services */
.services-section{padding:145px 0 125px}.service-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}.service-card{position:relative;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e9edf1;border-radius:26px;padding:29px 30px 32px;min-height:245px;box-shadow:0 14px 35px #171e2508;transition:transform .3s,box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s}.service-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 20px 55px #151e3015;border-color:#e5e8eb}.service-index{position:absolute;top:32px;right:29px;font-size:11px;font-weight:760;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#b4bac2}.service-icon{width:45px;height:45px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:15px;background:#fff0f1;color:var(--red);margin:0 0 29px}.service-icon svg{width:22px;height:22px}.service-card h3{font-size:19px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:0 0 10px;font-weight:740}.service-card p{font-size:14px;color:#747d87;line-height:1.65;margin:0;max-width:36ch}.services-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;margin-top:22px;background:#fefefe;border:1px solid #e9edf1;padding:19px 26px;border-radius:22px;color:#626b75;font-size:14px}.services-cta a{font-weight:740;color:var(--red)}.services-cta a span{margin-left:7px}
/* Scroll visual documentary */
.story-section{padding:65px 0 40px}.story-heading{margin-bottom:43px}.story-scroller{height:260vh;position:relative}.story-sticky{position:sticky;top:94px;height:calc(100vh - 116px);min-height:480px;margin:0 auto;width:min(calc(100% - /* Technical photographic / 3D later */
.systems-section{padding-top:123px;padding-bottom:142px}.systems-panel{background:#0d1013;border-radius:34px;padding:18px;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 30px 95px #0b111b2f;overflow:hidden}.system-photo{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:23px;background:#090b0d}.system-photo img{width:100%;height:auto;max-height:690px;object-fit:cover}.system-photo:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#090c10a5,transparent 34%)}.system-photo-label{position:absolute;top:24px;left:27px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#ffffff16;border:1px solid #ffffff31;backdrop-filter:blur(13px);padding:11px 17px;border-radius:999px;font-size:11px;font-weight:760;letter-spacing:.12em;z-index:2}.systems-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:22px 12px 14px}.system-tab{padding:12px 18px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffffff0a;color:#d1d8df;border:1px solid #ffffff1c;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:710;transition:.2s}.system-tab.active{background:#fff;color:#13171b;border-color:#fff}.system-tab:hover{border-color:#ffffff6b}.system-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:190px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:18px;border:1px solid #ffffff1d;border-radius:23px;padding:20px 25px;background:#ffffff0d}.system-small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;font-weight:740;color:#8c97a4}.system-summary h3{margin:0 0 5px;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.04em}.system-summary p{color:#c2cbd3;font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;max-width:600px;margin:0}.system-summary a{color:#fff;font-size:13px;font-weight:740;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff4f;padding:9px 0;white-space:nowrap}.system-summary a:hover{color:#ff8588}
/* Gallery */
.gallery-section{background:#f9fafb;border-top:1px solid #e9edf0;border-bottom:1px solid #e9edf0}.gallery-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:16px;grid-auto-flow:row;margin-top:45px}.gallery-item{position:relative;border:0;padding:0;overflow:hidden;border-radius:24px;cursor:zoom-in;min-height:300px;text-align:left;background:#111;box-shadow:0 16px 44px #0000000d}.gallery-item img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;position:absolute;inset:0;transition:transform .65s ease,filter .65s ease}.gallery-item:hover img{transform:scale(1.055);filter:saturate(1.08)}.gallery-item:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#05070bad,transparent 42%)}.gallery-item>span{position:absolute;bottom:23px;left:25px;right:25px;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:730}.gallery-item>span span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:31px;height:31px;border:1px solid #ffffff5c;border-radius:50%;font-size:15px}.gallery-wide{aspect-ratio:1.5/1}.gallery-small{aspect-ratio:1.25/1}.gallery-disclaimer{font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;color:#8c939d;margin:23px 0 0}
/* Location */
.location-section{padding:136px 0}.location-shell{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:20px}.location-content,.map-island{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e6e9ec;border-radius:30px;box-shadow:0 18px 55px #1118270b}.location-content{padding:48px 45px 46px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}.location-content h2{margin:25px 0 17px;font-size:clamp(42px,4.5vw,64px);line-height:1.01;letter-spacing:-.078em}.location-content h2 span{color:var(--red)}.location-content>p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.75;color:#6a747f;max-width:440px;margin:0 0 27px}.address-island{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;padding:17px 18px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid #e8ebee;background:#f8fafb;width:100%;max-width:410px}.address-pin{width:39px;height:39px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#ffedef;border-radius:13px;color:var(--red);font-size:21px;font-weight:800;flex-shrink:0}.address-island strong{display:block;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:-.025em}.address-island div>span{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#717a84;margin-top:5px}.location-buttons{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:28px}.location-buttons .button{padding:15px 20px;font-size:13px}.map-island{padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:480px}.map-topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:11px 13px 18px;color:#858c95;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;font-weight:780}.map-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}.map-status>span{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red)}.map-island iframe{width:100%;min-height:360px;flex:1;border:0;border-radius:19px;background:#e8eae8}.map-external{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:19px 10px 7px;font-size:13px;font-weight:750;color:#393f46}.map-external:hover{color:var(--red)}
/* CTA footer */
.final-cta{padding:0 0 112px}.cta-shell{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:35px;padding:59px /* SC — distribuição editorial de novas imagens geradas (2026-10-22) */
.services-feature{margin-top:23px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:.87fr 1.13fr;min-height:330px;border:1px solid #e8ebef;background:#fff;border-radius:27px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 15px 44px #14171b0a}
.services-feature-copy{padding:39px 43px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start}
.services-feature-copy h3{font-size:clamp(27px,2.75vw,39px);letter-spacing:-.055em;line-height:1.14;margin:15px 0 12px;max-width:470px}
.services-feature-copy h3 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--red)}
.services-feature-copy p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:#69727e;max-width:430px;margin:0 0 18px}
.services-feature-copy a{font-size:13px;font-weight:760;color:var(--red);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.services-feature-media{position:relative;min-height:330px;overflow:hidden;background:#14191e}
.services-feature-media img{width:100%;height:100%;position:absolute;inset:0;object-fit:cover;object-position:48% 50%;transition:transform .8s ease}
.services-feature:hover .services-feature-media img{transform:scale(1.035)}
.media-chip{position:absolute;left:19px;bottom:19px;padding:11px 15px;border-radius:999px;background:#ffffffdb;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);color:#2b323a;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:800}
.location-photo{position:relative;margin:23px 0 20px;max-height:185px;aspect-ratio:2.6/1;border-radius:19px;overflow:hidden;background:#171b20}
.location-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 55%}
.location-photo:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#0b0e137a,transparent 60%);pointer-events:none}
.location-photo figcaption{position:absolute;bottom:13px;left:15px;right:15px;color:#fff;z-index:1;font-size:12px;font-weight:740;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.location-photo small{font-size:10px;background:#ffffffd9;color:#2e333a;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:920px){.services-feature{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.services-feature-copy{padding:30px 27px}}
@media(max-width:640px){.services-feature{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:0;border-radius:23px}.services-feature-copy{padding:28px 23px 27px}.services-feature-copy h3{font-size:30px}.services-feature-media{min-height:240px;order:-1}.location-photo{max-height:none;aspect-ratio:1.9/1}.location-photo small{font-size:9px}}

/* SC real video controlled by scroll */
.story-scroller{height:410vh}
.story-photo-stack img#storyFrame{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center center;opacity:1;transition:none;transform:none;image-rendering:auto}
.story-count#storyTime{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.13em;padding:11px 16px;border:1px solid #ffffff44;background:#0a0c1044;border-radius:999px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);right:5%;top:27px;white-space:nowrap}
.story-photo-shade{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#030608a8 0%,#03060844 45%,transparent 85%),linear-gradient(0deg,#020406ad 0%,transparent 45%);pointer-events:none}
.story-caption{pointer-events:none;max-width:640px;left:5%;bottom:12%}
.story-caption-text strong{font-size:clamp(36px,5vw,68px)}
.story-caption-text p{max-width:380px}
.story-progress{background:#ffffff66}
.gallery-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-auto-flow:row}
.gallery-item{min-width:0;min-height:260px}
